metadata.intended_use: AI-readable structured summary of unstructured Bosch Brand Guide web pages for research, prompt engineering, design governance, and downstream design generation.

brand.name: Bosch
brand.brand_design_purpose: Provide a comprehensive set of tools for all aspects of Bosch Corporate Design, enabling a uniform Bosch image and a convincing brand experience across touchpoints.
brand.core_message: Design makes the Bosch brand authentically visible and translates brand positioning into a tangible, consistent experience.

scope: Basic corporate design elements such as symbol/logotype and Supergraphic
primary_objectives: Make the Bosch brand tangible and recognizable
Support consistent application across business units, media, and touchpoints

brand_structure_metaphor.phrase: Many fibres. One rope. Many units. One brand.
brand_structure_metaphor.meaning: Bosch's many business units and fields of expertise should appear as one unified brand through consistent corporate design.

corporate_design.definition: The visual representation of Bosch brand positioning.
corporate_design.role: Transforms abstract brand values into visible design decisions, creating recognition and coherence.

brand_experience.design_language_role: A distinctive design language delivers a compelling experience, makes the brand tangible, and highlights Bosch values.

brand_promise.quality: Quality is treated as a Bosch brand promise and must be reflected in design, not only in products or services.
brand_promise.simplicity: Design should be minimalistic, functional, and focused on user experience.
brand_promise.agility_and_diversity: The visual language should be adaptable and should express the diversity of Bosch divisions and contexts.

visual_identity.summary: Bosch's broad range of expertise makes the brand unique. Corporate design visualizes this whole and makes the brand identity perceptible.
visual_identity.application_rule: When creating visual material, preserve a unified Bosch identity even when the topic belongs to a specific division or product area.

flat_design.summary: Bosch design is minimalistic and reduced to essentials. It combines Bosch design elements with clear and open surfaces, lively colors, rectangular shapes, and clear edges.
do: Use rectangular shapes and clear edges
Use color purposefully to structure information or create emphasis
dont: Do not use decorative drop shadows
Do not use rounded edges as a dominant visual language
Do not add ornamental effects that reduce clarity

less_is_more.summary: Design elements should be used only where needed. Color and visual emphasis should support user experience and avoid clutter.
do: Use design elements for functional reasons
Emphasize only the elements that need attention
dont: Do not overload layouts with unnecessary shapes, colors, or decorative elements
Do not use color without a clear communicative purpose

high_quality.summary: Design should reflect Bosch's promise of quality across all business fields and touchpoints.
dont: Do not create inconsistent or improvised visual systems
Do not sacrifice legibility for decoration

symbol_logotype.role: Primary brand identifier optimized for clarity and recognition.
symbol_logotype.usage_intent: Use consistently as a corporate identity anchor when brand attribution is required.

supergraphic.role: Key colored design element representing Bosch strengths and adaptability.

symbolism.invented_for_life: Represents Bosch's guiding idea of technology serving life.
symbolism.color_variety: Represents agility and diversity across divisions.

supergraphic.usage_intent: Use as a distinctive brand framing or accent element when a Bosch-branded look is needed.

colors.role: Support brand recognition, hierarchy, emphasis, accessibility, agility, and diversity.
colors.application_rule: Use colors prudently and with clear hierarchy. Avoid unnecessary color noise.

layout_principle.role: Flexible layout logic for adapting Bosch identity across different touchpoints.
layout_principle.application_rule: Prioritize clear structure, openness, functional hierarchy, and consistency.

imagery_style.role: Make Bosch relatable, human-centric, and authentic.
imagery_style.application_rule: Use imagery that feels realistic and supports the brand story rather than purely decorative visuals.

typography.role: Primary font for headings, body text, captions, links, buttons, and UI elements.
typography.application_rule: Use Bosch Sans consistently to preserve readability and brand continuity.

icons.role: Support a consistent visual language through a shared icon library.
icons.application_rule: Use icons functionally to clarify meaning, not as decoration.

for_layout_generation: Use flat design with clear rectangular geometry and no decorative shadows.
Keep the composition open, simple, and functional.
Use blue as a functional interactive/accent color and reserve warning colors for warnings only.
Use the Supergraphic or color accents to create Bosch recognition when appropriate.
for_copy_or_messaging: Emphasize quality, clarity, technology serving people, and Invented for life.
for_visual_consistency_checks: Check whether the design uses Bosch Sans or an acceptable fallback.
Check whether shapes are mostly rectangular and clear-edged.
Check whether color has a functional purpose.
Check whether the layout avoids clutter and unnecessary decoration.
Check whether imagery supports a lifelike and human-centric brand impression.
